name: Writer API
plain: Writes new text from a prompt on the device.
meaning: Generates drafts locally; the page controls tone and length.

access.prompt_ui: Joint origin trial with Rewriter; flag chrome://flags/#writer-api
access.iframe: Same as top level; cross-origin iframes need a permissions policy where listed

data.metric: Writes new text from a prompt on the device.

limits.headline: Can draft new text from a prompt on your device, only in Chrome and Edge testing
limits.user_action: You type a short instruction and tap a button like Draft for me
can: Draft new text from a prompt you give the page
Match a tone and length the page sets
Keep the text on your device
cannot: Work for normal visitors yet, since it is an origin trial
Work in Firefox, Safari or on phones
Draft anything without a prompt from the page or you
Send your prompt to a server for this feature
limits.differs: Only a Chrome and Edge testing trial today. Not in Firefox, Safari or on phones.

story.what_it_is: A page can write new text from your prompt using an AI model on your device.

marketing.name: Writer API
marketing.pitch: Lets sites draft new text from a short prompt with Chrome's built in on device AI.

story.for_you: You type a short request, like a thank you note, and a draft appears. It runs on your device, so your request stays with you. Only some browsers have it for now.
story.for_makers: Makers add drafting tools with no cloud costs and no data sharing. It helps users start writing faster. It is in testing, so it is not for everyone.

use_cases.example: A web email app drafts a reply when you type three words of what to say.
A seller tool drafts a product listing from a few bullet points.
A post box drafts a caption from a short idea.
A web editor writes a first outline of a doc.
A study site drafts practice questions from your notes.
A support tool drafts a first reply to a customer, ready for the agent to edit.
A game tool writes character backstories from a few traits for a story game.
A page helps a person write a message when typing is hard, by turning a few words into a full note.

technical_bounds: Gemini Nano hardware: Windows 10 or 11, macOS 13+, Linux, or ChromeOS Plus; 22 GB free disk; GPU over 4 GB VRAM or CPU with 16 GB RAM and 4 cores
